summary: Freebuff is an ad-supported coding agent available as a CLI, desktop app, web app builder, cloud IDE, and chat. Its current Free pricing lists $1.50 refilled daily, estimated as up to 10 hours of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash or 2 hours of Claude Haiku 5.5 per day when used on one model, with no card required. The allowance resets at local midnight and unused daily allowance does not roll over. These are full-access estimates: account and regional allowances vary, fair-use limits apply, and model prices and allowances may change. Sign in to confirm your account's allowance. The official README instead calls DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM 5.3 Flash unmetered at full access, conflicting with metered pricing; unlimited access is not verified. The embedded X announcement is historical evidence, not an account-specific guarantee.
claim_steps: Review the Free plan at https://freebuff.com/plans; displayed hours assume full access. Sign in to confirm your account's allowance.
Install the CLI (Node.js 18+): npm install -g freebuff
Run freebuff and describe what you want. Confirm the applicable account allowance before use; the Free plan states no card required, but account-free CLI onboarding has not been reverified.
Or use another Freebuff product: Desktop (freebuff.com/desktop), Web (freebuff.com/web), Cloud (freebuff.com/cloud), or Chat (freebuff.com/chat).
Use the daily allowance on one model or a mix; it resets at local midnight and does not roll over. Regional and fair-use limits may reduce access; the README/pricing conflict needs confirmation.
